quranTranslation.text: Keep to forgiveness (O Muhammad), and enjoin kindness, and turn away from the ignorant.

explanation.bs: „…i okreni se od neznalica“ – pohvalno ne obazirati se.
explanation.en: “…and turn away from the ignorant” — a praised disregard.

quranTranslation.text: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection.

explanation.bs: „A ko se okrene od Moje opomene, njegov će život biti tegoban“ – pokuđeno okretanje.
explanation.en: “But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life” — a blamed turning away.

quranTranslation.text: Those are they, the secrets of whose hearts Allah knoweth. So oppose them and admonish them, and address them in plain terms about their souls.

explanation.bs: „Zato se okreni od njih i savjetuj ih“ – ne obazirati se, a ipak opominjati.
explanation.en: The Prophet is told to turn away from them (فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ) and yet admonish them — disregard, and yet admonish.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away, lo! Allah loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).

explanation.bs: „Reci: Pokoravajte se Allahu i Poslaniku. Pa ako se okrenu…“ – okretanje leđa kao odbijanje poslušnosti.
explanation.en: “Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away…” — turning away as refusing obedience.

gloss.en: to turn away; to take as ally

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and His messenger, and turn not away from him when ye hear (him speak).

explanation.bs: „…i ne okrećite se od njega dok slušate“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje je odvraćanje neslušanje i neposluh.
explanation.en: “…and turn not away from him when ye hear (him speak)” — ar-Rāġib: here the turning away is by not listening and not obeying.

gloss.en: to turn away; to take as ally

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Take not the Jews and the Christians for friends. They are friends one to another. He among you who taketh them for friends is (one) of them. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „A ko ih od vas uzme za zaštitnike, on je od njih“ – تَوَلَّى bez ‚od‘: prihvatiti za zaštitnika.
explanation.en: “He among you who taketh them for friends is (one) of them” — تَوَلَّى without ‘from’: to take as ally.

gloss.en: to turn away; to take as ally

quranTranslation.text: Only those believe in Our revelations who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and hymn the praise of their Lord, and they are not scornful,

explanation.bs: „… koji, kad se njima opomenu, padnu ničice i hvale svoga Gospodara …“ – pad i zvuk slavljenja zajedno, kako ar-Rāġib objašnjava.
explanation.en: “who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and hymn the praise of their Lord” — the fall and the sound of glorifying together, as ar-Rāġib explains.

quranTranslation.text: And when We decreed death for him, nothing showed his death to them save a creeping creature of the earth which gnawed away his staff. And when he fell the jinn saw clearly how, if they had known the Unseen, they would not have continued in despised toil.

explanation.bs: „… pa kad se srušio, džinima je postalo jasno …“ – Sulejmanovo tijelo pada kad je štap izgrižen; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when he fell the jinn saw clearly” — Solomon's body falls once the staff is gnawed through; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place.

explanation.bs: „… kao da se srušio s neba, pa ga ptice zgrabe ili ga vjetar odnese i strmoglavi na dalek kraj.“ – oba glagola u jednom ajetu: خَرَّ za pad s neba, تَهْوِي za strmoglavljivanje.
explanation.en: “it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown [tahwī] him to a far-off place” — both verbs in one ayah: خَرَّ for the fall from the sky, تَهْوِي for being swept down.

quranTranslation.text: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.

explanation.bs: „… a onaj na koga se sruči Moja srdžba – taj je propao.“ – doslovno ‚strmoglavio se‘; mnogi mufessiri: propao je; Allahova srdžba, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost [hawā] indeed.” — literally ‘he has plunged’; many mufassirun: he has perished; Allah's wrath, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And with Him are the keys of the Invisible. None but He knoweth them. And He knoweth what is in the land and the sea. Not a leaf falleth but He knoweth it, not a grain amid the darkness of the earth, naught of wet or dry but (it is noted) in a clear record.

explanation.bs: „… nema lista koji opadne, a da ga On ne zna …“ – Allahovo znanje, kako Njemu priliči, obuhvata i pad jednog lista.
explanation.en: “Not a leaf falleth [tasquṭu] but He knoweth it” — Allah's knowledge, as befits Him, takes in even the fall of a leaf.

quranTranslation.text: Of them is he who saith: Grant me leave (to stay at home) and tempt me not. Surely it is into temptation that they (thus) have fallen. Lo! hell verily is all around the disbelievers.

explanation.bs: „… Eto, u iskušenje su pali! …“ – pad kao s visine; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Surely it is into temptation that they (thus) have fallen.” — a fall as from a height; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
